_metadata.description: Finish metadata for variant-level description personalization
_metadata.notes: Each finish has: category, description_type (coordination vs statement), functional_description, style_affinities (for collection matching), opening_phrase (for natural sentence integration), style_context (fixture coordination), platform_hints (platform-specific emphasis)

_platform_hints.shopify: Emphasize design aesthetic and buyer appeal
